Same comments as the one you pushed for Manufacturer.
Reference: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/79207?tab=comments
We have BuildDate in the Asset interface... Any possibility of reuse? Or do we just duplicate all/most properties across physical and SW inventory?
As per the comments in https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/79207?tab=comments floated this MR
You should specify an acceptable format for the date. It can't be an arbitrary string...
Added acceptable format
RO flag?
Added RO flag

I see there is also a proposed "Software.Manufacturer".  I don't really like many 1-property interfaces that daemons have to pick and choose which ones they implement, partially because it makes the clients combinatorially more complex (and you can't use the template that combines multiple interfaces together into a single C++ object).

Should we either:
1. Extend ExternalVersion to have a number of additional 'optional' properties?  By 'optional' I mean properties which could have an empty string.
2. Add one more SoftwareAsset interface with these additional properties.

As per the suggestion, created SoftwareAsset interface. 
Should the properties be optional ?
Marking the conversation as resolved. Will re-open if there is suggestion to have the properties as optional. But on other interface like Decorator.Asset the properties cannot be empty.

what is manufacturer information?  

is this an invitation to place any free form information desired by the manufacturer?
 (is software manufactured?)
 _ a search says no it's developed (for now at least) _
 
 or did you intend to identify something about the the supplier
Added description as per the schema

so I can't tell if it was produced exactly at midnight or at some unknown time?

can we instead optionally omit the time portion starting with the T when it's unknown?

hmm redfish seems to say do it as described. in section 9.5.5

> When the time of day is unknown or serves no purpose, the service shall report 00:00:00Z for the time of day value.

While we could be more precise internally it might be of little value.

This design is followed in all the other interfaces as well like Decorator.Asset. 
So maintained the same here
@patrick@stwcx.xyz @paligill@gmail.com @anoo@us.ibm.com could you please review this ?

Lets rename the file to Asset.interface.yaml instead as Software is already in the path so xyz.openbmc_project.Software.SoftwareAsset seems reduandant, better to change this to just Asset for xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Asset interface name.

I get these information from smbios-mdr records. If its helpful I can add the information. But, I m not sure if there is any property on redfish for this

@prithvi24pai@gmail.com Would this interface be used as an optional interface in BMCWeb? The reason i am asking so is because there are multiple repos which implements software update and every repo won't have this interface implemented at the moment?
Yes, I want to check if the information exists only then have the redfish property. @gunnar@gmills.xyz please share your thoughts
@paligill@gmail.com could you please re-review this PR ?

@prithvi24pai@gmail.com I am fine as long as you are checking if the property exists as you cannot error out in case some updaters haven't implemented this interface yet.

Can you please raise a patch to add this interface to list at https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/designs/code-update.md#proposed-d-bus-interface.
Sure, once this PR is merged I will raise a PR on the suggested document. The reason for this is all the dbus interfaces in the code-update.md is in merged state
